The bitcoinj application opens no TLS sessions (tls_sessions scan: none found); this is shipped-library surface, changeable only by upgrading/pruning the vendored BC copy.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: bitcoinj application SHA-256 (Bitcoin doubleDigest for block/tx hashing, and the SHA-256 half of sha256hash160). NOTE for the inventory: the SECOND half of sha256hash160 (Utils.java:198, new RIPEMD160Digest() → doFinal at 201) is a live RIPEMD-160 op chain in application code — the method is collected under this SHA-256 object, so the RIPEMD-160 asset is recorded here. RIPEMD-160 is quantum-relevant (Grover halves collision resistance) and protocol-fixed by the Bitcoin P2PKH address format RIPEM
